meta.title: {name} — Digital invitations that feel like an event

hero.titleStart: Invitations your guests actually want to
hero.lede: Pokanito designs scroll-animated digital invitations for weddings, birthdays, christenings and company events — a beautiful, personal page your guests open on their phone, RSVP through, and remember.

what.lede: We design and personalize the page, host it, and hand you a link — you focus on throwing the party.

features.title: Handpicked templates
features.text: Every template is built for one kind of event, with the fun details — countdowns, timelines, maps — that occasion actually deserves.

features.title: Personalized for you
features.text: Send us your details — names, date, venue, photos — and we'll turn them into your own version of the template. No design skills required.

features.title: One link to share
features.text: Your invitation lives at its own page. Drop it in the group chat — no app to install, no account for your guests to create.

steps.title: Choose a template
steps.text: Browse the gallery and pick the design that fits your event.

steps.title: Tell us about it
steps.text: Send your details through the contact form — names, date, venue, photos.

steps.title: We personalize it
steps.text: We build your version of the template and send you a preview link.

steps.title: It goes live
steps.text: Your invitation is published at its own link, ready to share.

templates.title: Pick your vibe
templates.lede: Every template is a real, working invitation. Tap one to open the live demo on your phone.

items.q: Do my guests need an app or an account?
items.a: No. They open a link in WhatsApp, Viber or SMS and everything works in the phone browser.

items.q: Can we change details after it’s published?
items.a: Yes. The link stays the same, so guests always see the latest program, time or venue.

items.q: How do we see who is coming?
items.a: Every RSVP is sent straight to your email, with names, number of guests and menu choices.

items.q: How long does the invitation stay online?
items.a: [N] months after the event, so guests can come back to the photos and memories.
